{{Top|leg}}
The '''Horonna''' plant grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was ubiquitous in the Cularin jungles. It was green in color, and this shade formed the base color for [[Tarasin]] skin. In the Tarasin [[Tarasin Skintone Language|skintone language]], such a color indicated the individual was at ease.<ref name="Shades of Meaning">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011011a_shades&c=swlfc|text=Shades of Meaning}}</ref>
